goal: Stop RPC and REST endpoints from falsely reporting confirmed transactions as missing on I/O or index errors
Surface disk read failures and index corruption explicitly to notify users of potential data problems
Distinguish pruned or downloading blocks from missing transactions in raw transaction lookups
reviewability: All reviewer questions and suggestions have been addressed
agreement: Strong support for separating unexpected read failures from transactions not found (yuvicc, musaHaruna)
Strong support for throwing on index corruption instead of reporting transactions missing (ryanofsky)
Earlier concern about error messages for pruned blocks resolved with block availability checks (yuvicc)

categories.name: indexes
why: P2 because silently reporting missing transactions masks data integrity problems and corruption in txindex
Alerts node operators to underlying system or disk corruption rather than returning empty results

categories.name: rpc
why: P2 because callers no longer receive misleading not-found errors when confirmed transactions fail to read
Provides accurate error feedback across raw transaction and REST endpoints for I/O errors and pruned blocks
